title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
subtitle: A standalone, cooperative campaign game of tactical combat
tagline: You are the Jaws of the Lion
loreSummary: You are a member of 'Jaws of the Lion', one of the most infamous mercenary groups in this run-down backwater. When a sinister cult starts making people disappear, it falls to you to get to the bottom of it.
keyFeatures: Learn to play with a 5-scenario tutorial
Play directly in the scenario book - no map tiles to assemble

core_campaign.name: Full Campaign
core_campaign.description: Play all 25 scenarios, completing the main story and all side quests.

main_story.name: Main Story Only
main_story.description: Focus purely on the 17 core narrative scenarios, ignoring side missions.

milestones.title: Welcome to the Black Barrow
milestones.description: Completing the 5-scenario introductory tutorial and unlocking the full capabilities of your character.

milestones.title: The City Sewers
milestones.description: Investigating the strange disappearances in the city and discovering the cult's underground lair.

milestones.title: The Blood God
milestones.description: The final showdown against the leader of the cult and their dark patron.
